rules.statement: An application under section 51 of the Insolvency Ordinance is an action within the meaning of section 2 of the Courts Ordinance and comes within the ambit of section 10 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Such a proceeding is an action within the meaning of section 2 of the Courts Ordinance and comes within the ambit of section 10 of the Prescription Ordinance."
